title: Pay in the country: six dollars a night
summary: Pay was six dollars a man a night; he earlier worked in the field for two bits a day.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: How much did the dancers pay in those days?

We was getting six dollars a night. Six dollars a man. Six dollars a man. Wasn't bad, wasn't it? No. We already got a dollar and a half a night in the district. That was big money, see. I got two and a half a night on Saturday night when I first started playing. That's all I got. And could live a whole week. Well I was working in the field for two bits a day. Yeah. That's what made me learn how to play music so soon, see. Because I wanted my car in time. I wore that in the field. Mm-hmm.
